children: Daiwa said China’s solar glass market showed signs of price recovery and capacity adjustments as of Sept. 3, but the industry still faces oversupply pressure, according to ETNet.

The broker kept its negative view on the sector, reiterated underperform ratings on Flat Glass H-shares (06865) and Xinyi Solar (00968), maintained a sell rating on Flat Glass A-shares (SSE:601865), and assigned a hold rating to Foster (SSE:603806).

title: Daiwa Sees China Solar Glass Prices Recovering But Keeps Negative View
